WITH state_shares AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(state_county_province, '') AS state_county_province,
    COUNT(*) AS account_base,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(19, 4)) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM Customers
  GROUP BY COALESCE(state_county_province, '')
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_of_total) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.account_base) AS combined_account_base,
  AVG(s.share_of_total) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share_of_total - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_above_average_share
FROM state_shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share_of_total > a.avg_share
